I am a junior lecturer in the Internet Engineering Technology (Teknologi Rekayasa Internet, TRI) program at Universitas Gadjah Mada, Yogyakarta. My research focuses on deep learning for computer vision and time series classification, with work on eye tracking and medical image analysis.

 Grid


 List




20251 item




Conference paper 


A Systematic Literature Review of Transfer Learning for Eye Tracking


ICADEIS 2025 · IEEE


A review of 29 studies (2018–2024) showing how transfer learning addresses data scarcity and individual variability in gaze classification and estimation, with best practices for preprocessing and fine-tuning.






20242 items




Conference paper 


Robust Fetal Head Circumference Calculation on Ultrasound Images Using Just-in-Time Compiled Ellipse Fitting


TENCON 2024 · IEEE


A fast, memory-efficient method based on JIT-compiled Randomized Hough Transform ellipse fitting, reaching Dice 0.93 and Hausdorff 3.88 mm in 0.41 s per image with under 800 kB of memory.




Book review 


Personalized medicine meets artificial intelligence: beyond “hype”, towards the metaverse


Informatics for Health and Social Care · Taylor & Francis


A review of a book on how AI and personalized medicine are shaping digital health, data-driven care, and patient outcomes.
